name: @buhera/registry
description: Buhera federation registry for TypeScript hosts: the Module contract, the module registry (dispatch + audit log + post-dispatch hooks), the DSL registry, the catalogue conformance check, and the module adapters. Twin of the Rust crates buhera-registry + buhera-modules.
